description: Owner-approved license exceptions. `exceptions` is for the NuGet license gate in tools/scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1: a package is exempt only when BOTH its id and its exact version match an entry. Any other version of these packages, and any other package outside docs/allowed-licenses.json, still fails the gate. A new version needs a new owner approval (D-00, D-18). `npmLicenseExceptions` is for the npm license gate in web/scripts/license-gate.mjs: those exceptions are license-level (any package under that license) and apply to the dev/build tree of web/ and tools/openapi-gen/ only, never to the production tree that ships to the browser, which allows only docs/allowed-licenses.json plus OFL-1.1 for the @fontsource fonts (D-26). In both gates, an entry that no longer matches a package also fails, so the lists cannot go stale.
